biomarkers.name: CDX2 / CK20
biomarkers.clinical_use: Supports intestinal-type classification (occupational  wood dust exposure)

biomarkers.name: TP53
biomarkers.clinical_use: Primarily reflects recurrent molecular alteration; prognostic value is not firmly established

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Two distinct groups: intestinal-type (ITAC) resembling colonic adenocarcinoma; non-intestinal-type (non-ITAC) with variable morphology
histomorphological_subtype.grading: Barnes grading for ITAC (papillary I to solid IV)

tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: ITAC has intestinal-type stroma; non-ITAC variable

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Intestinal-type: metaplastic intestinal epithelium from chronic irritation; non-intestinal: sinonasal minor mucous glands
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Intestinal-type recapitulates colonic adenocarcinoma differentiation (CDX2+/CK20+); non-ITAC ranges from low-grade to high-grade
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Intestinal metaplasia from chronic wood dust exposure is the initiating event for ITAC  precursor lesion is documented
